name: heme
description: A heme is any tetrapyrrolic chelate of iron. Membership is recognised structurally: an iron atom bonded to four five-membered-ring nitrogens. The SMARTS does not constrain the oxidation state, formal charges or axial ligands of the iron, nor how the Fe-N bonds are drawn, so it matches ferrohemes, ferrihemes, hemin and hematin alike, while zinc, magnesium and cobalt tetrapyrroles, free-base porphyrins and ferrocene do not match.
